about: The forensic flashlight (add-forensic-flashlight), held on B. Its light is a disco ball floating in front of the player. ball: where it floats relative to the eye (metres: right, up, back; -Z is ahead) and how fast it spins (turns per second). beams: the ring of spotlights it throws (count, colours alternating, sRGB; intensity in lumens; width in degrees; range in metres; tilt below the horizon in degrees, alternating so spots land near and far). reveal: a collectible within range_m and inside width_deg of a beam flares, then fades over fade_seconds. hologram: rim and core colours (sRGB; glow multiplies them for bloom), scanlines per metre and their scroll speed, flicker 0..1. beacon: the column and diamond over each revealed collectible.
